Resolves #18121
Refs #17844

`WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL` runs its gesture again. Since 09-08 every arm had failed in setup, before any window moved, so the popup-over-popup drop had no working witness.
- The journey looked its cross-window participations up by the engine `className`. PR #18469 made the Workstation's main target a `Workstation.window.Participation` subclass, and the lookup missed it: `popOut`'s re-registration poll never passed, and the vessel-registration check received two of three. The lookup now matches the `ntype` a subclass keeps.
- Each pop-out now also requires the main window to retire its stand-in, and the transfer requires that neither the main window nor the target vessel keeps one. A stand-in left behind is the defect class #18676 names: a pane lost from view behind "Moving pane to another window…".

Evidence: L3 achieved — the whole spec runs headed against the external Brain runtime at the head, six times → L3 required, since it moves native OS windows, headless Chrome skips its shrink arms, and no CI workflow runs it. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | The journey runs: at e293feaf57 all three arms pass the `popOut` re-registration wait and the registration check, headed, and go on to their gestures. Before the fix, every #17844 census since 09-08 recorded them red at that wait (latest dev@3044d7f86b), and a headed run at 4add999757 with only that wait relaxed stopped at the registration check, receiving two of three. |
| AC-2 | `--repeat-each=5` at e293feaf57 (dev 4add999757 plus this spec change): 15 passed, each of the three arms 5/5 consecutively. |
| AC-3 | `WorkstationNativeTitlebarDragNL` passed 1/1 in the validation run at the head. |

## Deltas from ticket
- The ticket's author re-scoped AC-1 during review. It first required attributing the three 09-02 symptoms; it now requires that the journey actually runs. Those symptoms occurred in none of the six headed runs at the head (18 arm executions), and the ticket keeps them as unattributed sightings for whoever next reproduces one.
- The stand-in assertions are new. Nothing in the journey looked at a stand-in, so a pane left behind one could not fail it. They have not failed on any head, because no measured path leaves a stand-in behind.

## Test Evidence
- `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=<neo-agent-brain> NEO_E2E_PORT=8163 npx playwright test 'workstation/WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL\.spec' -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs --workers=1 --headed`:

  - at e293feaf57 with `--repeat-each=5`: 15 passed (1.6m).
  - at the #18678 head (5898c273e8) with this spec checked out on top: 3 passed (20.0s).
- With the lookup fixed, the arms also pass at 7bd4db9f74 and at 4add999757, before and after #18667.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted in the Engine; the baseline jobs run.
